title: Eukaryotic mRNA End Processing: 5′ Capping and 3′ Polyadenylation
method: Unicode lexical count of saved HTML teaching-prose paragraphs; excludes headings, tables, SVG, figures, questions, answers, revision and references. Article count includes supplementary visible text and SVG labels, excludes SVG title/desc and diagram buttons.

comparator.method: Same Unicode lexical counting method applied to exemplar HTML

scientific_checks: Official revised NET syllabus Unit 3.B and archived MP SET 2024 syllabus pages 2–3 visually checked.
Cap phosphate origin, GTP and SAM chemistry, cap 0/1/2, Ser5 CTD recruitment, CBC/eIF4E distinctions.
Mammalian PAS context, CPSF recognition versus CPSF73 catalysis, CstF, two cleavage products, XRN2 distinction, ATP incorporation and PABPN1.
Cap–tail cooperation, APA isoforms and absolute versus relative abundance, oocyte tail changes, histone stem-loop and U7 exception, bacterial and organellar comparisons.
Historical 1971 polyadenylate and 1975 cap evidence source-checked; original hypothetical scenarios labeled; first-order decay and conditional yields recomputed.

academic_self_review.method: Internal editorial self-assessment, not external independent review
